Entry requirements · 2027 entry

Economics BA at UCLA

What UCLA asks of applicants to Economics BA for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

US · All UCLA courses · Economics & Finance field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 7 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • SAT/ACT scores are not considered for admission or scholarships
  • Scores, if submitted, may be used only to meet minimum eligibility requirements or for course placement
Verified19 Oct 2026UCLA: First-Year Requirements
English language
  • English proficiency required if you had less than 3 years of instruction in English at a school where English was not the language of instruction
  • Tests:
    • TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo English Test
    • results self-reported on the UC Application by January

UCLA publishes “competitive” scores (TOEFL iBT 5+ on the revised scale or above 100 on the old scale, IELTS 7.5+, Duolingo 135+), not minimum scores, so no score is shown as a requirement. (Its FAQ calls these the “recommended scores” for being as competitive as possible.)

Verified19 Oct 2026UCLA: International Applicants
Admissions tests

None listed on the official source

UCLA’s first-year requirements are the A–G courses, the UC Application and the Personal Insight Questions; no admissions test is required for these majors (supplemental applications apply only to arts, music, nursing and theater/film majors).

Verified19 Oct 2026UCLA: First-Year Requirements
Subject prerequisites
  • Not used in Altiora’s matching yet — see the note for the official guidance

Official (UC A–G, as listed by UCLA): 15 A–G courses, at least 11 finished before the last year of high school — 2 years history/social science; 4 years college-preparatory English; 3 years mathematics (4 recommended); 2 years laboratory science (3 recommended); 2 years language other than English (3 recommended); 1 year visual and performing arts (if available); 1 year college-preparatory elective. If a required subject is not available, UCLA considers the application without it. For the College of Letters and Science the applicant’s major is not considered in review, so no major-specific subjects apply.

Partly verified19 Oct 2026UCLA: First-Year Requirements · UCLA: Application Review Process for First-Years
A-Level requirements
Grades
Not recorded
Details
International applicants report external exam results — and predicted results, if the school releases them — in the UC Application’s “International External Exams” section; predictions are used in review, and upcoming exams such as A levels must be taken as listed.

UCLA states no A-Level grade requirement.

Verified19 Oct 2026UCLA: International Admission Guide (fall 2027 cycle)
IB requirements
Overall score
Not recorded
Details
Performance in IB Higher Level courses and exceptional performance on IBHL exams are considered in review, where such courses are available.

UCLA’s pages refer to IB Higher Level courses/exams, not to the IB Diploma as an entry qualification, so accepted is left unknown.

Verified19 Oct 2026UCLA: Application Review Process for First-Years
Other qualifications
  • AP courses and exceptional performance on AP exams are considered in review (not required)

Samueli AP credit after admission is a credit policy, not an admission requirement, and is not recorded here.

Verified19 Oct 2026UCLA: Application Review Process for First-Years
Other requirements
  • UC Personal Insight Questions: answer 4 of 8 (max 350 words each)
  • No admission interviews; letters of recommendation not required or accepted
